normative_extracts.quote: An object is considered garbage-collectable if there are zero references pointing to it, or if it is unreachable from the root.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: In V8, all inner functions in a scope share a single heap-allocated Context object; one retained closure keeps every captured sibling variable alive.

production_failures.symptom: SPA memory grows by 50MB per route navigation until tab crash
production_failures.root_cause: Global event listeners or setInterval callbacks hold closures referencing unmounted DOM nodes, retaining entire detached DOM subtrees.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass an AbortController signal to addEventListener and abort it on component unmount.

production_failures.symptom: 10MB ArrayBuffer stays pinned in memory even though the active handler never reads it
production_failures.root_cause: A sibling closure in the same lexical scope referenced the buffer, causing V8 to retain the shared Context object.
production_failures.mitigation: Nullify large temporary variables after setup or isolate closures into separate helper scopes.
